Name: Friendship Decay Rebalanced Realistic Social System
Author: jkysa88
Description:
💡 Features[list]
[*]💬 [b]Talk or lose friendship[/b] — skip greetings and watch your points drop.
[*]🎁 [b]Optional weekly gift check[/b] — neglecting gifts also affects trust.
[*]⚙️ [b]Fully configurable via GMCM[/b]
[list]
[*]Customize decay by heart range (0~4 / 5~8 / 9 / 10+ / spouse 10~14).
[*]Adjust global intensity (0.25x–3.0x).
[*]
[*]Choose whether maximum hearts still decay.
[/list][*]🌍 [b]Multi-language support (English / KOREAN / 中文)[/b]
[list]
[*]Interface and in-game messages localize automatically.
[/list][/list][line]🧭 ConfigurationAccessible via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Basic[/b] → Enable mod, toggle realism mode.
[*][b]Decay Settings[/b] → Customize decay for each heart range.
[*][b]Spouse Decay[/b] → Control affection drop for married NPCs (10–14 hearts).
[*][b]No-Greet Penalty[/b] → Set how much friendship decreases when ignored.
[*][b]Notifications[/b] → Choose whether HUD messages appear or stay silent.
[/list][line]⚠️ Compatibility[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].
[*]Works alongside [b]Content Patcher[/b] or any dialogue mod.
[*]Requires [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for settings.
[/list][line]❤️ Author NotesThis mod is designed for players who want relationships to feel alive —
friendship is earned, not permanent.
Whether you prefer a light touch or brutal realism, you control it all.
